definition: A mandatory part of a Labour Market Impact Assessment application for a high-wage position, setting out what the employer will do to recruit, retain and train Canadians and permanent residents and to reduce reliance on the Temporary Foreign Worker Program.
longform: It is valid for the duration of the worker's employment and is generally not required for low-wage positions. It exists so that a positive assessment is tied to an employer's ongoing commitment, not only to a one-time recruitment exercise.
